_comment: Committed fixture for apps/mcp-hub/tests/test_impact.py -- a small graph
exercising every branch impact.compute_impact makes. Posture comes from
LINKS and arch.observation beads, never from a content field (round-2
#1020 gate finding: content.depends_on predates #513 and is blank on the
live estate) -- mirroring ea_dependency.py's land_dependency_posture:
- chg-1 (chg.with-affects) has outgoing affects edges to app-1 and app-2
- chg-2 (chg.without-affects) has no edges at all
- app-1 (app.known) carries an ACTIVE assessed-none arch.observation
(obs-1) -> known posture -- plus real depends_on/consumes edges to
ci-1 and svc-1 (an app can have both a dependency edge and an
assessed-none finding in this fixture; only the observation drives
its posture here)
- app-2 (app.unknown) has no depends_on edges and no observation ->
unknown posture, and carries no edges of its own
- app-3 (app.ci-only) depends_on a CI (ci-3) and consumes a service
(svc-2) but has no app-to-app depends_on edge and no observation ->
unknown posture (ea_dependency's own 'coherence case': a real edge,
just not an application-to-application one) -- content.depends_on is
blank, the live shape (round-2 #1020 gate finding)
- app-5 (app.dependent) depends_on app-6 -- an application-to-
application edge -> known posture, with no observation needed
- app-7 (app.sibling) ALSO depends_on app-6 -- a second, independent
consumer of the same dependency (round-2 #1024 gate finding: proves
the closure never walks forward into app-6 and back out to app-7 --
querying app.dependent must never return app.sibling)
- app-6 (app.leaf) has no outgoing edges and no observation -> unknown
- ci-1 (ci.owned) has an incoming depends_on edge (from app-1) -> owned
- ci-2 (ci.unowned) has no incoming edges -> unowned
- ci-3 (ci.observed-only) has an incoming depends_on edge (from app-3,
the unknown-posture app) -> owned, even though its owner is unknown
- svc-1 (svc.one) has an incoming consumes edge (from app-1)
- svc-2 (svc.observed-only) has an incoming consumes edge (from app-3,
the unknown-posture app)
- obs-1 is an active assessed-none arch.observation for app.known
(content.ref == obs.ea-dependency.app-known, matching
ea_dependency.dependency_assessment_ref('app.known'))

content.summary: A change with no recorded affects edges
